articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Zcash devs propose another block time cut days after NU7 upgrade
articles.description: The proposed reduction aims to shorten transaction confirmation times and improve the user experience for point-of-sale payments, exchange deposits and cross-chain swaps.

articles.title: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts
articles.description: The proposals aim to keep Ethereum’s planned gas changes from breaking existing contracts, using different approaches to what contracts see and what users pay.

articles.title: From supermarket fridges to passenger flights, a wave of threats is testing Europe's defenses
articles.description: Cyberattacks on fridges in supermarkets and a wave of bomb threats are testing Europe’s ability to withstand disruption to crucial infrastructure.

articles.title: Binance's bitcoin mining pool finds just one block in a week as shutdown nears
articles.description: The exchange's once significant mining operation has nearly disappeared from Bitcoin's block-production rankings ahead of its November 10 closure.

articles.title: tBTC bridge partially resumes as $120M Aave reserve remains frozen
articles.description: Threshold halted its tBTC bridge on Oct. 30 as operators addressed a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that could allow attackers to execute code on unpatched servers.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops, then pops as Nvidia cheating scandal and failed Iran talks trigger volatility
articles.description: Volatile price action has once again liquidated leveraged bullish plays worth millions.

articles.title: China wholesale inflation hits highest in more than four years as consumer measure slows
articles.description: The PPI for October came in at 5.7%, compared to the 5.3% expected by economists polled by Reuters.

articles.title: Vitalik ‘pivots’ ETH to store of value, crypto suffers after US midterms: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Vitalik Buterin wants Ethereum to embrace a store of value narrative, upsetting Bitcoin maxis. The crypto industry faces an uncertain future following the US elections.

articles.title: Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with alleged Chinese spy
articles.description: Huang told Nvidia staff in an email that he had an affair and that the company's board has opened an investigation into allegations the woman is a Chinese spy.

articles.title: Trump says renewed Iran strikes ‘highly unlikely’ if talks progress but warns he could still strike
articles.description: Trump tied avoiding renewed U.S. strikes to progress in talks over Iran’s nuclear program and the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: What the election results mean for crypto: State of Crypto
articles.description: Democrats had an astoundingly good night, smashing all expectations. Is that actually bad news for the industry?

articles.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
articles.description: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.

articles.title: Democrats amp up Trump investigation threats, Blanche counters he may probe lawmakers
articles.description: Democrats have vowed to investigate both President Donald Trump's White House and businesses that have worked with the administration.

articles.title: Here are the 2 big things we're watching in the stock market in the week ahead
articles.description: CoreWeave earnings and inflation data will take center stage.

articles.title: How Democrats will try to end Trump's tariffs
articles.description: Rep. Hakeem Jeffries, D-N.Y., who is likely the next House speaker, has made clear that ending President Trump's tariffs is one of Democrats' top priorities.

articles.title: Trump targets Slotkin in call for DOJ probe of alleged Democratic threats to Republicans
articles.description: Trump ordered DOJ to examine alleged threats against Republicans while singling out Slotkin.

articles.title: Recent AI agent experiments reveal a risky future of machine 'teamwork' inside corporations
articles.description: AI agents are now working together on a regular basis. Research shows they are not always seeking the same goal, or operating with ethics.

articles.title: This Bitcoin Developer’s Idea Would Make Quantum Attacks a Losing Bet
articles.description: Cory Fields wants future quantum attackers to post Bitcoin as collateral before touching vulnerable wallets, giving prepared owners a chance to recover their coins and collect a potentially costly penalty.

articles.title: Poppi founders are going after PepsiCo's Gatorade with new beverage startup Jetty
articles.description: Poppi founders Allison and Stephen Ellsworth are launching Jetty, a hydration brand selling bottled drinks and powders at Whole Foods, Target and Amazon.
